question: Should OpenClaw expose safetyDiagnostics.emit() and the safetyEventTypes manifest permission as a supported public plugin SDK contract, with the proposed durable operator-facing event history?
rationale: The patch can mechanically enforce provenance, but only maintainers can choose whether this safety telemetry API, its declared permissions, and its persistence/query semantics are a stable product commitment.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: An SDK/diagnostics owner confirms the capability, provenance semantics, retention behavior, and compatibility expectation, then the PR can proceed through normal validation.

options.title: Keep telemetry core-only for now
options.body: Remove or defer the plugin emission and manifest surfaces while retaining only the owner-approved internal observability work.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: An SDK/diagnostics owner confirms the capability, provenance semantics, retention behavior, and compatibility expectation, then the PR can proceed through normal validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is an owner-level decision about a new public plugin SDK and diagnostics contract rather than a contributor follow-up.
